decision: Run the founder newsletter on Kit's free plan. Send product-update and lifecycle emails to signed-up users through Resend (already in the stack) so app data drives them. Move to Loops if lifecycle email gets complex.
note: Consolidated: Kit is for a product's leads and users. Your personal founder newsletter lives on Substack (Personal brand track). Start Kit when the first product has a list.
